Take your CRM how you take your coffee: To go. With our mobile app, you can do business wherever it finds you.

## ⚙️ Capsule CRM Key Features ### Workflow Automation ![Capsule CRM Key Features: Workflow Automation](https://www.breakcold.com/cms/d869576f7a19f834.png) Capsule includes **native workflow automation**, though it’s important to note that this feature is only available on higher-tier plans — not on the Free or Starter tiers. With automation, you can configure Capsule to handle repetitive CRM tasks automatically, such as assigning opportunities to team members, creating projects, or sending follow-up emails. For instance, if you have a milestone for when a contract is drafted for a potential client — and a specific teammate manages that stage — you can set up an automation that reassigns the opportunity to them and applies a “Track” outlining the series of tasks they need to complete. | Did You Know? | |-| | While Capsule’s workflow automation does reduce admin work, its capabilities are relatively limited and don’t scale well as teams grow — especially considering it’s a paid-tier feature.
By contrast, Breakcold takes automation a step further. Leads move automatically based on your real-time interactions and conversations. You can even let Breakcold Vision decide when and how to trigger workflow actions — enabling smarter, more personalized automation that adapts to how you sell. | ## 🔁 Capsule CRM Alternatives ### 🥇 Breakcold CRM – Best Sales Focused CRM With AI-Native Features #### **Summary** It automates lead movement, tagging, and follow-ups across Email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, and soon Phone — eliminating the manual upkeep Capsule still requires. | Key Features | |-| | Auto Lead Movement – Leads move automatically in Breakcold’s CRM based on your interactions. No setup required — the AI understands and updates everything on its own.
Auto Task Creation – Monitors your interactions with leads and automatically creates follow-up tasks so you never lose momentum. Focus on selling, not admin work.
Vision Builder – By default, leads move automatically based on your list names and pipeline stages (zero setup). Want more control? Use natural language to build advanced AI CRM workflows.
AI-Powered Dashboard – A self-updating dashboard that highlights your most important tasks so you always know what to focus on next.
